canonicalization_rule: If Windows acceptance passes, this exact full-source ZIP becomes the Ver1.15 canonical source without rebuilding or repacking.
next_development_line_if_accepted: Ver1.15 series (first normal patch expected 1.151; next canonical number follows user instruction)

baseline.note: The sole Ver1.14 canonical baseline supplied/accepted in the PSLOG115 development line.

source_of_full_source.rule: Ver1.15 was implemented directly on a fresh extraction of the Ver1.14 canonical ZIP. Older canonical sources and PATCH/FIX chains were not replayed.

release_highlights: Updater remains a one-ZIP user workflow but adds meta/versionup.json so future root EXEs and application folders (for example DLL/helper folders) can be managed without redesigning the updater.
Windows distribution root policy remains: direct files are EXEs; all other application files live in folders. User data roots config/logbook/logbook_flr/bak/output are protected.
Ver1.15 Windows packages carry a compatibility legacy update manifest so Ver1.14 can install the transition release; Ver1.15+ prefers meta/versionup.json.
Help menu adds PSLogの更新履歴 immediately before PSLogについて; the history is stored in meta/UPDATE_HISTORY.txt.
Current-version UI displays use the shared storage.VERSION source rather than a release-number literal.
QSL quick processing becomes a staged workbench for QSL marks, JCC/JCG and HIS QTH; source log writes only on 保存.
JCC/JCG can be converted to HIS QTH in the QSL workbench using the existing shared JCC/JCG lookup logic.
Closing the QSL workbench with unsaved changes asks exactly: 変更内容を保存せず閉じますか？
